IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p257/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas says Qarun and his company were swallowed down to the seventh earth.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p257/r2.anchor: وعن ابن عباس أنه قال: خسف بهم إلى الأرض السابعة

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p257/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p257/r3.speaker: قتادة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p257/r3.claim: Qatada says it was related that they sink one stature each day and will continue sinking until resurrection.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p257/r3.anchor: وقال قتادة: ذكر لنا أنه يخسف بهم كل يوم قامة، فهم يتجلجلون فيها إلى يوم القيامة

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p257/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p257/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p257/r4.claim: Ibn Kathir passes over the strange Israelite reports about this story.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p257/r4.anchor: وقد ذكر ها هنا إسرائيليات [غريبة] (7) أضربنا عنها صفحا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p257#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p257#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p257#2/r1.claim: His wealth, servants, entourage, and own strength could neither avert God's punishment nor rescue him from the sinking.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p257#2/r1.anchor: ما أغنى عنه ماله، وما جمعه، ولا خدمه

JISHUMI:v8p5528/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5528/r2.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5528/r2.claim: Khasf is the sinking of the earth with whatever is upon it.

JISHUMI:v8p5528/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5528/r3.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5528/r3.claim: Fiʾa is a group gathered around a common cause, rooted in cutting; its diminutive is فئية.
JISHUMI:v8p5528/r3.anchor: والفئة: الجماعة المنقطعة إلى أمر تجتمع عليه، وأصله من فأوت رأسه بالسيف

JISHUMI:v8p5528/r12.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5528/r12.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v8p5528/r12.claim: The account follows the lesson that following false patrons and leaders avails nothing: Qarun’s money and followers did not help him.
JISHUMI:v8p5528/r12.anchor: وقيل: لما تقدم أن اتباع الأنداد والعظماء لا يغني شيئا أتبعه بذكر قارون، وأنه لم ينفعه المال والأتباع.

JISHUMI:v8p5534/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5534/r5.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5534/r5.claim: The sinking of Qarun is presented as punishment.
JISHUMI:v8p5534/r5.anchor: ويدل قوله: (فخسفنا) أن ذلك الخسف كان عقوبة.

JISHUMI:v8p5535/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5535/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5535/r1.claim: God may destroy someone deserving لطف so that the person learns it is temporary and does not become conceited; Jishumi applies this to Qarun’s house and adornment.
JISHUMI:v8p5535/r1.anchor: لذلك خسف بداره وزينته، وعلى هذا الوجه صحح أبو هاشم أن العين حق

JISHUMI:v8p5535/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5535/r2.speaker: أبو هاشم
JISHUMI:v8p5535/r2.claim: Abu Hashim uses this principle to affirm the evil eye: God destroys the admired person as لطف so admirers will not rely on worldly life.
JISHUMI:v8p5535/r2.anchor: وعلى هذا الوجه صحح أبو هاشم أن العين حق، وقال: إنما يهلكه الله لطفا كي لا يركن المستحسن إلى الدنيا

JISHUMI:v8p5535/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5535/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5535/r4.claim: The story gives many indications that human acts originate with the people who perform them.
JISHUMI:v8p5535/r4.anchor: وتدل على أن أفعال العباد حادثة من جهتهم من وجوه كثيرة، هي ظاهرة إن تأملتها

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p269#2/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p269#2/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p269#2/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas relates that after Moses complained to God, the earth was commanded to obey him; at Moses's successive commands it swallowed Qarun and his followers to their ankles, waists, and necks, then engulfed them, Qarun's house, and his treasures.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p269#2/r1.anchor: قال ابن عباس : لما شكا موسى إلى الله أمر قارون أمر الله الأرض أن تطيع موسى

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p269#2/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p269#2/r2.speaker: يزيد الرقاشي
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p269#2/r2.claim: Yazid al-Raqashi relates that when the earth had swallowed Qarun to his neck, Moses struck his face with his sandals; Qarun pleaded for mercy, and God reproached Moses, saying He would have answered Qarun had he called upon Him.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p269#2/r2.anchor: روى يزيد الرقاشي أن قارون لما أخذته الأرض إلى عنقه أخذ موسى نعليه فخفق بهما وجهه

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p269#2/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p269#2/r3.speaker: سمرة بن جندب
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p269#2/r3.claim: Samura ibn Jundub reports that Qarun and his people sink one stature each day and will not reach the lowest earth until the Resurrection.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p269#2/r3.anchor: روى سمرة بن جندب أنه يخسف بقارون وقومه في كل يوم بقدر قامة

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p269#2/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p269#2/r4.speaker: مقاتل
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p269#2/r4.claim: Muqatil says the Israelites accused Moses of destroying Qarun to inherit his wealth; three days later God sank Qarun's house and all his possessions.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p269#2/r4.anchor: قال مقاتل لما أمر موسى الأرض فابتلعته قال بنو إسرائيل : إنما أهلكه ليرث ماله

MUJAHID:v2p491#2/r1.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v2p491#2/r1.speaker: عبد الله بن الحارث بن نوفل
MUJAHID:v2p491#2/r1.claim: ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Harith ibn Nawfal reports that Qarun arranged for a woman to falsely accuse Moses of seduction; she exposed Qarun's instructions and denied that Moses had approached her.
MUJAHID:v2p491#2/r1.anchor: قال نا عبد الله بن الحارث بن نوفل قال كان قارون يؤذي موسى بكل أذى وكان ابن عمه

MUJAHID:v2p491#2/r2.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v2p491#2/r2.speaker: عبد الله بن الحارث بن نوفل
MUJAHID:v2p491#2/r2.claim: After Moses invoked God, the earth sank Qarun and his followers progressively to their ankles, knees, and waists, then swallowed them despite their pleas for Moses to pray for rescue.
MUJAHID:v2p491#2/r2.anchor: قال نا عبد الله بن الحارث بن نوفل قال كان قارون يؤذي موسى بكل أذى وكان ابن عمه

MUJAHID:v2p491#2/r3.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v2p491#2/r3.speaker: عبد الله بن الحارث بن نوفل
MUJAHID:v2p491#2/r3.claim: God rebuked Moses, saying that had he asked once, God would have shown mercy and saved Qarun and his followers.
MUJAHID:v2p491#2/r3.anchor: قال نا عبد الله بن الحارث بن نوفل قال كان قارون يؤذي موسى بكل أذى وكان ابن عمه

MUQATIL:28:80-81/r4.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:28:80-81/r4.speaker: author
MUQATIL:28:80-81/r4.claim: God commanded the earth to obey Moses; it seized Qarun up to his feet. Qarun appealed to kinship, but Moses ordered the earth to swallow him, and he sinks a man’s height daily until Judgment.
MUQATIL:28:80-81/r4.anchor: { فخسفنا به } يعني بقارون، وذلك أن الله عز وجل أمر الأرض أن تطيع موسى، عليه السلام، فأمر موسى الأرض أن تأخذ قارون

MUQATIL:28:80-81/r5.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:28:80-81/r5.speaker: author
MUQATIL:28:80-81/r5.claim: The Israelites accused Moses of destroying Qarun to seize his wealth and house; three days later God swallowed Qarun’s house and possessions, ending their accusation.
MUQATIL:28:80-81/r5.anchor: فقالت بنو إسرائيل: إن موسى إنما أهلك قارون حتى يأخذ ماله وداره، فخسف الله عز وجل بعد قارون بثلاثة أيام

MUQATIL:28:80-81/r6.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:28:80-81/r6.speaker: author
MUQATIL:28:80-81/r6.claim: Qarun had no troop to protect him from God and could not prevent the punishment of being swallowed.
MUQATIL:28:80-81/r6.anchor: يقول الله عز وجل: لم يكن لقارون جند يمنعونه من الله عز وجل

NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r1.claim: The account says Qarun opposed Moses, resented the zakat assessment, and persuaded the Israelites that Moses meant to take their property; he then paid a prostitute to accuse Moses of sexual misconduct.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r1.anchor: كان قارون يؤذي موسى عليه السلام كل وقت وهو يداريه للقرابة التي بينهما حتى نزلت الزكاة

NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r2.claim: At the festival Moses announced punishments for theft, false accusation, and illicit sex; when Qarun engineered an accusation against Moses, the woman confessed that Qarun had paid her, and Moses prayed to God while prostrating.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r2.anchor: فقالت جعل لي قارون جعلا على أن أقذفك بنفسي فخر موسى ساجدا يبكي وقال يا رب

NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r3.claim: God gave Moses command over the earth; it swallowed Qarun and his companions progressively to their necks and then closed over them as they pleaded with Moses, who remained angry.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r3.anchor: فقال يا بني اسرائيل إن الله بعثني إلى قارون كما بعثني إلى فرعون فمن كان معه فليلزم مكانه

NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r4.speaker: الله
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r4.claim: In the account, God tells Moses that Qarun had sought his help repeatedly without receiving mercy, and swears that a single appeal to God would have been answered with mercy.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r4.anchor: فقال الله تعالى استغاث بك مرار فلم ترحمه فوعزتي لو استرحمني مرة لرحمته

NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r5.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r5.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r5.claim: When some Israelites suspected Moses had destroyed Qarun to inherit his property, Moses prayed to God, and the earth swallowed Qarun's house and treasures too.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r5.anchor: فدعا الله حتى خسف بداره وكنوزه

NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r6.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r6.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r6.anchor: ﴿ فما كان له من فئة ﴾ جماعة

NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r7.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r7.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r7.claim: No group could protect Qarun from God's punishment.

NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r8.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r8.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r8.claim: Al-muntaṣirīn can mean those who take revenge on Moses or those who defend themselves against God's punishment; naṣara and intasara describe helping against an enemy and thereby resisting him.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p247#3/r8.anchor: من المنتقمين من موسى أو من الممتنعين من عذاب الله يقال نصره من عدوه فانتصر

QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r1.claim: The earth obeys Moses’ command, swallowing Qarun little by little along with his house and companions while he calls for Moses.
QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r1.anchor: فجاءه وهو يقول للأرض: يا أرض خذيه وهي تأخذه شيئا فشيئا

QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r2.claim: A report says God tells Moses that his servants called on Moses without mercy, though they would have found God near and responsive.
QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r2.anchor: أوحى إلى موسى: استغاث بك عبادي فلم ترحمهم، أما أنهم لو دعوني

QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r3.speaker: ابن جريج
QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r3.claim: Ibn Jurayj says Qarun and his people sink one stature each day and will not reach the earth’s bottom until Resurrection.
QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r3.anchor: ابن جريج: بلغنا أنه يخسف بهم كل يوم قامة

QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r4.speaker: يونس بن ميسرة بن حلبس
QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r4.claim: Ibn Abi al-Dunya transmits from Yunus ibn Maysara that Qarun met Jonah in the sea’s darkness and urged him to repent; Qarun said his repentance had been entrusted to Moses, his cousin, who refused him.
QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r4.anchor: عن يونس بن ميسرة بن حلبس قال: لقي قارون يونس في ظلمات البحر

QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r5.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r5.claim: A report says Israfil will blow the Trumpet when Qarun reaches the seventh earth’s bottom.
QURTUBI-FULL:28:76-77#2/r5.anchor: وفي الخبر: إذا وصل قارون إلى قرار الأرض السابعة نفخ إسرافيل في الصور

QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r1.speaker: مقاتل
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r1.claim: Maqatil says that after Moses ordered the earth to swallow Qarun, Israelites alleged Moses wanted his wealth; God swallowed Qarun, his house, and all his property after three days.
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r1.anchor: قال مقاتل: لما أمر موسى الأرض فابتلعته قالت بنو إسرائيل

QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r2.claim: God tells Moses that He will never again make the earth obey anyone after Moses.
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r2.anchor: فأوحى الله إلى موسى إني لا أعيد طاعة الأرض إلى أحد بعدك أبدا

QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r3.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r3.claim: Khasafa al-makān means a place disappeared into the earth; khasafa Allāhu bihi means God caused him to vanish into it.
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r3.anchor: يقال: خسف المكان يخسف خسوفا ذهب في الأرض

QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r4.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r4.claim: The wording permits both “he sank into the earth” and “he was made to sink into it.”
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r4.anchor: وخسف هو في الأرض وخسف به

QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r5.speaker: ثعلب
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r5.claim: Thaʿlab says the best usage is that the sun is eclipsed and the moon sinks into eclipse.
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r5.anchor: قال ثعلب: كسفت الشمس وخسف القمر هذا أجود الكلام

QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r6.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r6.claim: Khasf can also mean diminution or a reduction one accepts.
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r6.anchor: والخسف النقصان يقال: رضي فلان بالخسف أي بالنقيصة

QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r7.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r7.claim: Fiʾa means a group or band.

QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r8.claim: Muntaṣirūn means those able to protect themselves from the sinking that befell them.
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r8.anchor: أي الممتنعين فيما نزل به من الخسف

QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r9.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r9.claim: A report says Qarun sinks one stature each day until reaching the lowest earth, when Israfil blows the Trumpet.
QURTUBI-FULL:28:81-82/r9.anchor: فيروى أن قارون يسفل كل يوم بقدر قامة، حتى إذا بلغ قعر الأرض السفلى
